vocabulary.meaning_en: be able to do something
vocabulary.note_ar: لا تتغير مع he/she/it: نقول he can وليس he cans
vocabulary.note_en: It never changes: he can, not "he cans".

vocabulary.meaning_en: not be able to do something
vocabulary.note_en: can + not = cannot; the short form is can't.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the basic form of a verb, with no -s, -ed or -ing
vocabulary.note_ar: مثل play, eat, run، وليس plays أو playing
vocabulary.note_en: Like play, eat, run; not plays or playing.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word for an action or a feeling
move fast on your feet
move through water
move through the air
move on your hands and knees
make food hot and ready to eat
vocabulary.note_en: As a noun, a cook is a person who cooks (also: chef).
vocabulary.example: My mum can cook tasty food.

vocabulary.meaning_en: push yourself up into the air with your legs
go up something using your hands and feet
hit something with your foot
tidy the sheets and covers on a bed
vocabulary.note_ar: make لها معانٍ كثيرة: يصنع، يجعل، يرتب
vocabulary.note_en: Make has many meanings: to create, to cause, to tidy (a bed).

vocabulary.meaning_en: jump on one foot
vocabulary.example: Can she hop? Yes, she can hop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: move on your feet at a normal speed
seeing, hearing, smelling, tasting and touching
vocabulary.example: We learn about the world with the five senses.

vocabulary.meaning_en: use your eyes
vocabulary.example: I can see with my eyes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: use your ears
use your nose
use your tongue to know the flavour of food
vocabulary.example: I can taste with my tongue.

vocabulary.meaning_en: put your hand on something
vocabulary.example: I can touch with my hands.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the parts of your head you hear with
vocabulary.example: I can hear with my ears.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the part of your face you smell with
vocabulary.example: I can smell with my nose.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the soft part in your mouth you taste with
vocabulary.example: I can taste with my tongue.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the parts at the end of your arms
vocabulary.example: I can touch with my hands.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the parts a bird uses to fly
vocabulary.example: It has wings. It can fly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the thin parts a fish uses to swim
vocabulary.example: It has fins. It can swim.

vocabulary.meaning_en: using
vocabulary.example: I can see with my eyes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a big sea fish with sharp teeth
a female chicken

fine_lines.title: can vs can't
fine_lines.explanation_ar: can للقدرة (يستطيع)، و can't لعدم القدرة (لا يستطيع). كلاهما يأتي بعده فعل في المصدر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Can shows you are able to do something; can't shows you are not able. Both are followed by the infinitive.

fine_lines.title: jump vs hop
fine_lines.explanation_ar: jump قفز عادي بالرجلين، أما hop فهو القفز على رجل واحدة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Jump usually means jumping with both feet; hop means jumping on one foot.

examples.sentence: The children can jump over the rope.
Can you hop on your left foot?

fine_lines.title: can run vs can runs / can running
fine_lines.explanation_ar: بعد can يأتي الفعل في المصدر فقط بدون s أو ing وبدون to. الصحيح can run فقط.
fine_lines.explanation_en: After can, use only the infinitive: no -s, no -ing, no "to". Only "can run" is correct.

examples.sentence: Wrong: The lion can runs fast.
Wrong: The lion can running fast.

fine_lines.title: see vs hear
fine_lines.explanation_en: You see with your eyes and hear with your ears.

expressions.meaning_en: Saying you are able to swim.
expressions.example: I can swim, but I can't fly.

expressions.meaning_en: Saying you are not able to fly.
expressions.example: I'm not a bird. I can't fly.

expressions.meaning_en: Talking about what a baby can do.
expressions.example: The baby can crawl, but he can't walk.
Birds can fly because they have wings.
The chef can cook very well.
Come here! I can smell the flower.

expressions.phrase: I can see with my eyes.
expressions.meaning_en: Saying which body part you use for a sense.
expressions.example: I can see with my eyes and hear with my ears.

grammar.title: The infinitive (base form of the verb)
grammar.explanation_ar: الفعل قد تُضاف إليه إضافات مثل s أو ed أو ing (plays, played, playing). الفعل بدون أي إضافات يسمى الفعل في المصدر infinitive، مثل play, eat, read. swims ليس مصدرًا لأن فيه s، و reading ليس مصدرًا لأن فيه ing.
grammar.explanation_en: Verbs can take endings like -s, -ed or -ing (plays, played, playing). The verb with no endings is the infinitive: play, eat, read. "Swims" and "reading" are not infinitives.

grammar.title: can + infinitive (ability)
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم can للتعبير عن القدرة والاستطاعة. التركيب: الفاعل + can + فعل في المصدر. can لا تتغير مع أي فاعل.
grammar.explanation_en: Use can to talk about ability. Form: subject + can + infinitive. Can is the same with every subject.

grammar.title: can't + infinitive (no ability)
grammar.explanation_ar: للنفي نضيف not إلى can فتصبح cannot، واختصارها can't. يأتي بعدها فعل في المصدر أيضًا.
grammar.explanation_en: To make it negative, add not: cannot, or the short form can't. The infinitive still comes after it.

grammar.title: Senses with "with" + body part
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم with لنقول بأي جزء من الجسم نستخدم الحاسة، ونضع صفة الملكية my قبل الاسم.
grammar.explanation_en: Use with to say which body part you use, and put my before the noun.
examples: I can see with my eyes.
I can hear with my ears.
I can smell with my nose.
I can taste with my tongue.
I can touch with my hands.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد can يأتي الفعل في المصدر بدون إضافات.
questions.explanation_en: After can we use the infinitive with no endings.

questions.question: Which word is an infinitive?
questions.explanation_ar: eat بدون أي إضافات، فهي فعل في المصدر.
questions.explanation_en: Eat has no endings, so it is an infinitive.

questions.question: A bird has wings. It ___ fly.
questions.explanation_ar: الطائر له أجنحة فهو يستطيع أن يطير.
questions.explanation_en: A bird has wings, so it can fly.

questions.question: What does "climb" mean?
questions.explanation_ar: climb = يتسلق، وحرف b فيها صامت.
questions.explanation_en: Climb means to go up using your hands and feet. The b is silent.

questions.question: A hen ___ swim, but a shark can.
questions.explanation_ar: الدجاجة لا تستطيع السباحة، فنستخدم can't.
questions.explanation_en: A hen is not able to swim, so we use can't.

questions.question: What is the full form of "can't"?
Jump on one foot = ___
questions.explanation_en: Hop means to jump on one foot.

questions.question: Put the words in order: can / the chef / cook
questions.explanation_ar: الفاعل ثم can ثم الفعل في المصدر.
questions.explanation_en: Subject, then can, then the infinitive.

questions.question: Which sense do we use with our tongue?
